statements.new_statement_en: Israel should cut economic ties with hostile states, territories and organizations, including trade, money transfers and aid agencies, even if civilians there are harmed.

reason: Weight: UNRWA bills (rows 1, 4, 5, 40) about half; Gaza trade ban, Qatar enemy-state, essential-services and crossings bills (2, 3, 7, 14, 15, 20, 22, 25, 32, 34) about a quarter; freezing/deducting Palestinian Authority funds (6, 8-12, 17, 19, 23, 24, 26, 29-31, 39) about 15%. The current text covers trade and aid agencies but not the Authority money bills, and 'all' ties is broader than the specific cuts the bills make. Minimal rewrite: drop 'all', add 'money transfers'. Agree key unchanged (agree = less of the direction). Rows 13/18 (false complaints against soldiers), 27 (arms-embargo export), 28/36 (terror designations) are not economic ties and carry negligible weight.
